text.description_html:
SOSS Four-Piece Router Guide System RG4

The SOSS Router Guide System saves you time and measurements. The router guide templates can be positioned exactly to the hinge locations desired, and then locked into place. The system can be moved from door to door jamb, thereby eliminating time consuming measurements. The RG4 Four-Piece Router Guide System includes rail and four (4) router guide templates.

Sold Individually
